definitions.explanation: Wooden or wood-style flooring, as opposed to tatami or carpet. A common flooring choice in modern Japanese apartments and houses.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}はフローリングだ。
{畳|たたみ}をフローリングに{張|は}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I replaced the tatami with hardwood flooring.

examples.japanese: フローリングの{床|ゆか}はこまめに{掃除|そうじ}しないとホコリが{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: If you don't clean hardwood floors frequently, the dust becomes noticeable.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese real estate listings, フローリング is one of the most common floor types alongside {畳|たたみ} (tatami) and カーペット (carpet). Many modern Japanese apartments feature フローリング in living areas and bedrooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フローリングの{床|ゆか} (hardwood floor)
- フローリングに{張|は}り{替|か}える (replace with hardwood flooring)
- フローリング{用|よう}ワックス (floor wax for hardwood)
- フローリングモップ (floor mop for hardwood)

ETYMOLOGY:
From English "flooring." In Japanese, this term specifically refers to wood or wood-style flooring, not flooring in general.
